instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Dark-First Utility guidelines rigorously. The app should feel like a high-end engineering diagnostic tool. Avoid any soft, playful, or generic AI aesthetics.
Use deep obsidian/slate backgrounds (#090D14 and #151B23) with electric cyan (#00E5FF) exclusively for primary accents, active states, and VERIFIED badges.
Typography must enforce the technical feel: Use Rajdhani for display/metrics and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Adhere strictly to the 500 max font weight rule.
Ensure every screen has an AI Engineer Chat Floating Action Button (FAB). Use glassmorphism (expo-blur) over a brandTertiary tinted background for the FAB.
For the AI Analysis Result screen, implement a progressive disclosure architecture. Use the INSIDE OUT LAYERS (1-8) as a vertical stepper or segmented control. Tap-to-drill-down is essential.
In the BOM Table, group line items by category and allow rows to expand for detail, matching the mobile-first estimation layout from web search research.
For all background images, apply the mandatory gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee text legibility.
Status indicators (VERIFIED/INFERRED/ESTIMATED/UNKNOWN) should be color-coded strictly according to the status token colors (Cyan, Yellow, Yellow, Grey) and remain highly legible.
